params.message:
A report's source list is set again by Gentells

The link step could only lay a link over the addresses the designers
printed, so the page a reader saw still named the way out, and finding
those addresses in each new design was a guess. The pages that hold the
designers' list are now taken out and the list is set in their place
from the sources held for the report: publisher, title, date, and the
address of the source's page on gentells.com, the whole entry linked.

A page is replaced only when it is a source list beyond doubt (a source
heading with addresses of the list on it, or three or more of them).
Otherwise the stamped links stand and the outcome says so. The
designers' file is kept as it came.

Portal: De bronnenlijst achteraan een rapport wordt nu door Gentells zelf gezet, met bij elke bron het adres van haar pagina op gentells.com.
